post.summary: Create a document with the provided parameters. A document can be created using either an eFile upload key, or a network location URL.

parameters.name: Prefer
parameters.description:
* return=representation: This is the default. The server includes an entity representing the current state of the resource. In response to a successful request a status of 201 would be returned.
* return=minimal: The response will not include the entity in the response. A successful request would result in a status of 204 to be returned.

requestBody.description: The model containing the document to be created.

201.description: Returns the document that was created.

204.description: Document was created but will not be provided in response.

400.description: If the request parameters were invalid.

401.description: If the user is not authenticated.

403.description: If the current user is not authorized to perform this action.

500.description: If a server error has occurred.

get.summary: Look up and retrieve a document by the provided identifier.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Represents an identifier of a document.

parameters.name: If-None-Match
parameters.description: Executes a request only if the passed ETag doesn't equal the current resource ETag (i.e. resource hasn't changed).

200.description: Returns a document with the specified identifier.

ETag.description: Entity tag is part of HTTP provided for web cache validation problem, but also used for optimistic concurrency control.

schema.description: Entity tag is part of HTTP provided for web cache validation problem, but also used for optimistic concurrency control.

304.description: Returns a not modified response with empty body.

401.description: If the user is not authenticated.

403.description: If the current user is not authorized to perform this action.

404.description: If a document is not found.

500.description: If a server error has occurred.

patch.summary: Update the document with the provided identifier.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the document to be updated.

parameters.name: Prefer
parameters.description:

* return=minimal: The response will not include the entity in the response. A successful request would result in a status of 204 to be returned.

requestBody.description: The model containing the document to be updated.

200.description: Returns the document that was updated.

204.description: Document was updated but will not be provided in response.

400.description: If the request parameters were invalid.

401.description: If the user is not authenticated.

403.description: If the current user is not authorized to perform this action.
